desc: Intimation of Press Release in respect of Best Use of AI in Customer Service Award at India CX Strategy and Summit 2026

One Point One Solutions Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 28/08/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. To consider the proposal for fund raising by the Company, by way of, inter alia, issue of equity shares or any other equity linked instruments or securities including convertible preference shares and warrants entitling the warrant holder(s) to apply for equity shares, or any other eligible securities through, inter alia, a Private Placement or through one or more Qualified Institutions Placements (QIP''s) or further public issue of Equity or through any other permissible mode and/or combination thereof as may be considered appropriate subject to such approvals as may be required including the approval of the members at general meetings and further subject to such other Statutory /Regulatory/Lender's approval as applicable. 2. Any other business with the permission of Chairman
